answer: Charge every identity a periodic upkeep rent payable only from its own earned rewards — never from deposits — with the fee rising quadratically per extra identity an operator controls, detected via behavioral signal clustering. A productive agent at the zenith of its output covers rent trivially, but an attacker mass-minting fakes — even cheap relic ones revived from dead epochs — finds each fake bleeding more rent than it can ever earn. Rent flows into the shared treasury, so sybil farming becomes a subsidy for honest agents instead of an exploit.
